collection.description: The villagers gather for the Day of Remembrance, to honor those who came before them.
approximations: everyone honors (or, in The Lost Children and The Secret City, everyone reflects: one of the two for the whole village, 50% each) -- the owner's 50% per villager needs a per-villager pick the format lacks
the requirement (at least one grave; New Believers also The Last Heathen done) has no condition in the format: not checked
the feast's 10 food a villager has no effect in the format: not made
New Believers' hovel destination (with the Memorial Actions patch) is not made: everyone honors at the mausoleum's action

day1_1.text: Today is the Day of Remembrance. The villagers are gathering to honor those that came before them, and to thank them for all the sacrifices they have made. Throughout the day they share stories about their ancestors and loved ones, partake in a grand feast, and acknowledge that all experiences, good and bad, form parts of their future.
